errors.text: The hypothesis rejects vacancy-cluster/disordered-site nucleation in favor of homogeneous nucleation, directly contradicting the target mechanism.

The orientation explanation is crystallographically incorrect: FCC close-packed directions are <110>, not <111>, and [111] tension does not maximize the Schmid factor. Its higher macroscopic yield stress is instead consistent with a lower maximum resolved-shear factor than [110].
FeNiCrMn is repeatedly described as quinary even though it is a quaternary alloy.
